claims.statement: 백두진 1953-02-28 8500만달러 청산 완료 발언과 이승만 1953-03-04 8700만달러 수일내 도착 발언은 동일한 회계적 사실을 일치되게 증명한다
contradicting_or_limiting_evidence: two speaker statements differ in 85m vs 87m and already-settled vs future receipt
claims.conclusion: Both primary statements authentic as statements; not enough to infer same tranche or determine actual settlement. Preserve exact amounts and tense. Reconcile against FRUS NSC118 Feb9 $171m claim/$139m authority and bank deposit ledger.

claims.statement: 1953-03-04 김유택 총재가 추가 통화조치가 없다고 발표했으므로 이후 어떠한 통화·금융규제 변경도 불가능했다
claims.conclusion: Contemporaneous forward-looking pledge is not proof of subsequent nonaction. Requires post-March laws and Bank of Korea policy ledger.

claims.statement: 서울시는 1953-02-19 비상미 11000석과 구호양곡 9300석을 주민에게 모두 배급했다
claims.conclusion: Kyunghyang report distinguishes city announcement from lagging neighborhood execution and refusal without new banknotes; final delivery quantities unverified.

claims.statement: 1953년 통화개혁은 객관적으로 실패했다는 데 당시 모든 관찰자와 후대 기관이 합의했다
claims.conclusion: Minju Sinbo contemporaneous critique and later BOK positive retrospective have different authorship, timing, metrics and incentives. Need inflation and bank liquidity series; no simple single-score verdict.

claims.statement: 김유택 3월4일 2000만달러 외화방출 및 12억환 산업자금 언급은 이미 해당 자금이 전액 기업에 지급됐다는 증거다
claims.conclusion: Statement describes plan, expected collection and future lending; bank lending ledgers and import receipts needed.
